description.plain_text: Keylight 2.3v6.539224 Keylight is an industry-proven blue and green screen keyer. The core algorithm was developed by the Computer Film Company and has been further developed by The Foundry. Use the Screen Colour selector to choose a colour from the Source to use as the blue/green screen colour. Use the View option menu to judge the key. To remove blue/green spill from the foreground object, use the Despill Bias selector to pick skin tones from the Source. Use the Screen Matte parameters to improve the matte. Read the Keylight PDF User Guide for further information. Help->Documentation contains a more detailed description of this plug-in. Copyright 2026 The Foundry & Framestore all rights reserved.
description.text:
Keylight 2.3v6.539224

Keylight is an industry-proven blue and green screen keyer. The core algorithm was developed by the Computer Film Company and has been further developed by The Foundry.

Use the Screen Colour selector to choose a colour from the Source to use as the blue/green screen colour. Use the View option menu to judge the key. To remove blue/green spill from the foreground object, use the Despill Bias selector to pick skin tones from the Source.

Use the Screen Matte parameters to improve the matte.

Read the Keylight PDF User Guide for further information.

Help->Documentation contains a more detailed description of this plug-in.
